d: Short, messy charcoal black hair with long bangs and a single stray strand curving upward, framing a youthful, teenage face with wide, bright mint-green eyes. A slender build wearing a white kimono with a red collar, cinched at the waist by a gold obi and a dark forest-green hakama. The attire is accessorized with a dark grey headband featuring a red accent, while large, dark metallic naval gun machinery is positioned behind the back.
